_readme: Decklist card names that the card database does not carry under that exact spelling.
Shape: "<name as printed in decklists>": <Card ID in cards.json>
Names are matched after normalisation (see src/lib/normalize.ts), so case,
punctuation and accents do not matter here.
Add an entry only for a naming variant of the SAME card - never to substitute
a different card. Matches are reported to the user as alias matches.
Keys that are not strings mapping to a number are ignored.
